tools.name: start_quiz
tools.description: Start an anonymous EQVector short quiz of 24 questions in English or Thai. Returns a new session_id and the first question only (index 1, choices A and B). Answers are submitted with answer_question; the finished quiz returns a brief result with a deep link to the full test on eqvector.com. Not a cl

tools.name: answer_question
tools.description: Submit choice A or B for the current question of an anonymous session. Takes the session_id and the 1-based index of the current question. Returns the next question, or the brief result and a deep link to the full test after the last answer. Not a clinical diagnosis; not intended for hiring or scree

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: Read the brief MBTI-style summary for a finished anonymous session: four letters, a one or two line description, a confidence label, and a deep link to the full 140-question test on eqvector.com. The full report, Enneagram, Tritype, and AI Coach are not included. Not a clinical diagnosis; not intend

tools.name: lookup_celebrity
tools.description: Find a celebrity or fictional character in the EQVector database and return up to 5 matches with MBTI, Enneagram and a link to the profile on eqvector.com. Links are deep links with UTM tags. Not a clinical diagnosis. Not for hiring or screening.

tools.name: compare_types
tools.description: Key differences between two MBTI types (letters, dominant functions, shared functions), EQVector's compatibility score, and the link to the full comparison page on eqvector.com. Links are deep links with UTM tags. Not a clinical diagnosis. Not for hiring or screening.

tools.name: get_type_info
tools.description: Short summary of one MBTI type: nickname, preferences, cognitive functions, a few famous examples, and links to the type, celebrity and character pages on eqvector.com. Links are deep links with UTM tags. Not a clinical diagnosis. Not for hiring or screening.

tools.name: compatibility
tools.description: Work, love and friendship fit between two MBTI types from EQVector's compare data, with the compatibility score and the canonical compare page link. Links are deep links with UTM tags. Not a clinical diagnosis. Not for hiring or screening.

tools.name: enneagram_wing_info
tools.description: One Enneagram wing (e.g. 4w5): nickname, core type, number of profiles in the EQVector database, the most common MBTI types among them, and the wing page link. Links are deep links with UTM tags. Not a clinical diagnosis. Not for hiring or screening.

tools.name: search_by_type
tools.description: List celebrities or fictional characters of one MBTI type from the EQVector database, with Enneagram and profile links. Links are deep links with UTM tags. Not a clinical diagnosis. Not for hiring or screening.
